legend: There are n$$$n$$$ people in the programming contest chat. Chat participants are ordered by activity, but each person sees himself at the top of the list.
For example, there are 4$$$4$$$ participants in the chat, and their order is [2,3,1,4]$$$[2, 3, 1, 4]$$$. Then

k$$$k$$$ people posted screenshots in the chat, which show the order of participants shown to this user. The screenshots were taken within a short period of time, and the order of participants has not changed.
Your task is to determine whether there is a certain order that all screenshots correspond to.
input: The first line contains a single integer t$$$t$$$ (1≤t≤104$$$1 \le t \le 10^4$$$) — the number of input test cases. The descriptions of test cases follow.

The first line of the description of each test case contains two integers n$$$n$$$ and k$$$k$$$ (1≤k≤n≤2⋅105,n⋅k≤2⋅105$$$1 \le k \le n \le 2 \cdot 10^5, n \cdot k \le 2 \cdot 10^5$$$) — the number of chat participants and the number of participants who posted screenshots.
The following k$$$k$$$ lines contain descriptions of screenshots posted by the participants.

The i$$$i$$$-th row contains n$$$n$$$ integers aij$$$a_{ij}$$$ each (1≤aij≤n$$$1 \le a_{ij} \le n$$$, all aij$$$a_{ij}$$$ are different) — the order of participants shown to the participant ai0$$$a_{i0}$$$, where ai0$$$a_{i0}$$$ — the author of the screenshot. You can show that in the screenshot description it will always be at the top of the list.
It is guaranteed that the sum of n⋅k$$$n \cdot k$$$ for all test cases does not exceed 2⋅105$$$2 \cdot 10^5$$$. It is also guaranteed that all the authors of the screenshots are different.
output: Output t$$$t$$$ lines, each of which is the answer to the corresponding test case. As an answer, output "YES" if there exists at least one order of participants, under which all k$$$k$$$ screenshots could have been obtained. Otherwise, output "NO".
You can output the answer in any case (upper or lower). For example, the strings "yEs", "yes", "Yes", and "YES" will be recognized as positive responses.

legend.ai: 编程竞赛聊天中有 n$$$n$$$ 个人。聊天参与者按照活跃度排序，但每个人看到的列表顶部都是自己。
有 k$$$k$$$ 个人在聊天中发布了截图，这些截图展示了该用户所看到的参与者顺序。截图是在很短的时间内拍摄的，参与者的顺序没有发生变化。
你的任务是判断是否存在一个确定的顺序，使所有截图都与之对应。

input.ai: 第一行包含一个整数 t$$$t$$$ (1≤t≤104$$$1 \le t \le 10^4$$$)——输入测试用例的数量。下面给出各测试用例的描述。
每个测试用例的描述的第一行包含两个整数 n$$$n$$$ 和 k$$$k$$$ (1≤k≤n≤2⋅105,n⋅k≤2⋅105$$$1 \le k \le n \le 2 \cdot 10^5, n \cdot k \le 2 \cdot 10^5$$$)——聊天参与者的数量以及发布截图的参与者数量。
接下来的 k$$$k$$$ 行包含参与者发布的截图的描述。
第 i$$$i$$$ 行包含 n$$$n$$$ 个整数 aij$$$a_{ij}$$$(1≤aij≤n$$$1 \le a_{ij} \le n$$$，所有 aij$$$a_{ij}$$$ 互不相同)——这是展示给参与者 ai0$$$a_{i0}$$$ 的参与者顺序，其中 ai0$$$a_{i0}$$$ 是截图的作者。可以证明，在截图的描述中，截图作者总是位于列表顶部。
保证所有测试用例中 n⋅k$$$n \cdot k$$$ 的总和不超过 2⋅105$$$2 \cdot 10^5$$$。还保证所有截图的作者互不相同。

output.ai: 输出 t$$$t$$$ 行，每行是对应测试用例的答案。如果存在至少一种参与者顺序，使得在该顺序下可以得到全部 k$$$k$$$ 张截图，则输出 "YES"；否则输出 "NO"。
你可以使用任意大小写输出答案。例如，字符串 "yEs"、"yes"、"Yes" 和 "YES" 都会被识别为肯定回答。
